title: Paid AI attempts reserve concurrent budget and reconcile actual usage before returning

source.ref: owner reliability audit: failed accounting reads/writes and concurrent paid admission

detail:
Final mandatory reservation/settlement runtime release follows LIVE-888 central attribution preparation, LIVE-889/LIVE-890 atomic caller migrations and the independently recovered owner-approved SQL072 schema. The shipped implementation consequence probe verifies the final paid admission boundary.

Central Anthropic wrappers require attribution, obtain token quotes after the kill/configuration gate, reserve estimated input/cache-write plus bounded output allowance, disable hidden SDK retries and durably settle each tool round before callbacks. Migration072 serializes admission and settlement on the originating UTC day, enforcing global, feature aggregate and optional Space caps together. Provider/stream/callback/settlement failures retain observable uncertain reservations without expiry; actual overages are recorded truthfully and stop subsequent admission. Recraft generates and utility operations use the same boundary with documented tariff estimates. All shipped completion callers carry attribution; only zero-cost embedding writes remain in the legacy ledger helper and now await/check writes. Operator surfaces recorded, reserved, uncertain, pending IDs and unavailable accounting. Member quota reads retain their existing permissive failure policy, independently from fail-closed paid admission. Estimated concurrent admission is not a mathematical invoice cap. The owner-approved migration072 is applied and verified before final code rollout. No live provider calls or outbound sends were performed. Actual SQL passed23 PGlite assertions and the committed Supabase pgTAP replay passed all1,008 assertions across61 files on the LIVE-890 prerequisite. Historical usage remains1,977 rows and reservations0; private table and all five functions remain service-only.

2026-10-08 schema recovery only: migration20270346007200_ai_budget_reservations was already applied in production but absent from main, blocking repository/ledger parity across unrelated PRs. Recover the byte-identical authored SQL, generated schema types, service-only guard contracts and rollback-only pgTAP tests. Read-only production verification confirms the single exact ledger name, all five function-body hashes and reservation column shapes/grants. This adds no runtime AI accounting implementation, does not apply SQL again and does not close LIVE-883.
